verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs say next steps are "automatically captured and assigned from every meeting" and that summaries include action items. Its first-party integrations send action items into JIRA, Asana, and ClickUp, and the Public API exposes action items for retrieval, so the extracted items land somewhere trackable. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how owners are identified and assigned, documentation of an in-Otter action-item tracking view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction accuracy.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Clear next steps are automatically captured and assigned from every meeting.
Otter turns every meeting into a clear summary with decisions, action items, and insights.
Help your team move faster by sending actions items from meetings into tools they already use, like JIRA, Asana, and others.
Send meeting summaries and action items from Otter to ClickUp to manage everything in one place.
